meta_data.base_class: Reset the password of a user's <account type> account - refers to various online service or platform accounts that require user registration, login, and password-based authentication.

tool_template.name: reset_<class>_password
tool_template.description: Reset the password for a user's <class> account.

email.description: User's email address for <class> account recovery.

newPassword.description: New password to be set for the <class> account.

securityQuestionAnswer.description: User-selected security question and answer to enhance <class> account security during reset processes.

requestTimestamp.description: The timestamp of when the password reset request was initiated for the <class> account, in ISO 8601 format.

languagePreference.description: Preferred language for communication during the password reset process for the <class> account. Must be a valid IETF BCP 47 language tag.

notificationOption.description: Indicates whether the user should receive a notification after the password reset for the <class> account.

deviceFingerprint.description: A unique identifier for the user's device during the <class> password reset process, used for anomaly detection and account protection.
